title: MemIpfsStore RwLock unwrap panics on poisoned lock
description: In crates/transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs, MemIpfsStore uses RwLock::write().unwrap() and read().unwrap(). If any task panics while holding the lock the lock becomes poisoned and all subsequent accesses panic too, taking down the pipeline worker. Use unwrap_or_else or handle PoisonError gracefully.
